name: Obed
overview: Obed is a male biblical figure known primarily as the father of Azariah, as recorded in 2 Chronicles 23:1. No tribal affiliation or additional personal details are provided in Scripture. His mention is brief, focusing on his role within his family lineage.
namesAndTitles: The name Obed means 'servant' or 'worshiper,' reflecting a proper name of Hebrew origin. This meaning aligns with the biblical theme of devoted service to God, although the name was not given directly by God according to the record in 2 Chronicles 23:1.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture identifies Obed as the father of Azariah, establishing a direct paternal relationship. Beyond this, no other family connections or relationships are recorded for Obed in the biblical text.
scriptureSignificance: Obed's significance in the biblical narrative is tied to his role as the father of Azariah, who appears in the context of 2 Chronicles 23:1. While Obed himself is not a central figure, his mention helps trace the lineage and leadership within the historical setting of the Chronicles. His presence underscores the importance of family lines in the unfolding of God's providential history.
